name: @henryqw/pi-ask-question
description: Ask Pi users one interactive question with choices or a custom answer.

scripts.test:manual: pi --no-extensions -e ./extensions/ask-question.ts --tools ask_question --no-session "We need storage for a small team app. Before making changes, ask me to choose storage."
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck src/*.ts extensions/ask-question.ts test/*.test.ts
